QF.id: IV Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_43

question.text: Within what timeline must trading members / clearing members report any short-collection or non-collection of all margins from clients to the stock exchange?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook requires TMs / CMs to report actual short-collection / non-collection of all client margins to the stock exchange up to T+5 working days. Separately, clearing corporations send client-wise margin snapshots and members report end-of-day and peak margins collected. The Trap: The exchange does not require TMs to file a daily client-level margin report at T+0. Page 265 deals with daily margin statements to clients - which is different from exchange reporting. Monthly / quarterly cadences do not match the workbook. Note: Pages 263-265 and 267 set out the reporting chain: TM to CM, CM to SE/CC for collateral, and the T+5 reporting window for short/non-collection of margins.
